title: Stability and Logarithmic Foliations on Complex Projective Spaces
summary: We study Lyapunov-type stability for invariant algebraic divisors of codimension-one holomorphic foliations on complex projective spaces. Motivated by the notion of $L$-stability introduced in \cite{LeonScardua2018} for plane singularities, we define a projective stability condition which is compatible with the logarithmic setting and controls leafwise holonomy along the regular part of the invariant divisor, while discarding any stability requirement inside prescribed neighborhoods of its singular locus.
